To:Notice\_Operations@lists.ercot.com,Notice\_CRR@lists.ercot.com,Notice\_Contracts@lists.ercot.com

Sent:3/13/24, 4:10 PM

Subject:M-C031324-01 Notifications of Suspension of Operations (NSOs) for CPS Energy (BRAUNIG\_VHB1, BRAUNIG\_VHB2, BRAUNIG\_VHB3)

* * *

**NOTICE DATE:** March 13, 2024

**NOTICE TYPE:** M-C031324-01 Operations

**SHORT DESCRIPTION**: Notifications of Suspension of Operations (NSOs) for CPS Energy (BRAUNIG\_VHB1, BRAUNIG\_VHB2, BRAUNIG\_VHB3)

**INTENDED AUDIENCE:** ERCOT Market Participants

**DAY AFFECTED:** Comments Due April 3, 2024

**LONG DESCRIPTION:** On March 13, 2024, ERCOT received three (3) NSOs for the following Generation Resources:

- CPS Energy (BRAUNIG\_VHB1, BRAUNIG\_VHB2, BRAUNIG\_VHB3)

The NSOs indicate that, as of March 31, 2025, the Generation Resources will indefinitely suspend operations. The NSOs further indicate that the Generation Resources have a summer Seasonal Net Max Sustainable Rating of:

- BRAUNIG\_VHB1 ( **217 MW**)
- BRAUNIG\_VHB2 ( **230 MW**)
- BRAUNIG\_VHB3 ( **412 MW**)

and a summer Seasonal Net Minimum Sustainable Rating of:

- BRAUNIG\_VHB1 ( **60** **MW**)
- BRAUNIG\_VHB2 ( **60** **MW**)
- BRAUNIG\_VHB3 ( **70** **MW**)

Pursuant to ERCOT Protocol section 3.14.1.2(1), copies of the NSOs are posted under the Notice of Suspension of Operations portion of the [Generation](https://mis.ercot.com/secure/data-products/grid/generation) page of the ERCOT Market Information System (MIS) Secure Area.  An ERCOT Digital Certificate is required to access the MIS.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:** Please send any comments you may have regarding the NSOs to [RMRcomments@ercot.com](mailto:RMRcomments@ercot.com "mailto:RMRcomments@ercot.com"), with “CPS Energy (BRAUNIG\_VHB1, BRAUNIG\_VHB2, BRAUNIG\_VHB3) NSOs” in the subject line.  Comments are due no later than April 3, 2024. All comments will be posted to the [Generation](https://mis.ercot.com/secure/data-products/grid/generation) page of the MIS Secure Area.

**CONTACT:** If you have any questions, please contact your ERCOT Account Manager. You may also call the general ERCOT Client Services phone number at (512) 248-3900 or contact ERCOT Client Services via email at [ClientServices@ercot.com](mailto:ClientServices@ercot.com).

**If you are receiving email from a public ERCOT distribution list that you no longer wish to receive, please follow this link in order to unsubscribe from this list: [http://lists.ercot.com](http://lists.ercot.com/).**
